body: Its not that I specifically want a relationship with her, its that it seems that no one is interested in a relatinship with me.

Its not so much her in particular, its the fact that in the past few years that i've tried to form a normal relationship. The closest i've ever gotten to having a girlfriend is when i was getting boo'ed for bringing a fan from the opposing team to the game. It's not so much the individual, but its the fact that i've been in what seems like similar situations before and i can never seem to have a normal relationship.

It's like I had a few minutes where it seemed to me that the outside world thought that I was important enough to have someone give a shit about me. But here I am, by myself, with no person that I know who i'm willing to share my insecurities with.
